Monthly Hosting & Support

BluWeb™ Hosting, $35/mo per site: hosting, maintenance, security and backups, with your team making the updates in the drag and drop editor after training. Includes a video walkthrough and a full online support portal.

⚠ Heads Up On Hosting: Ongoing SEO Is Not Included

The site launches with basic on-page SEO, but the monthly technical SEO work that keeps a site ranking (keyword research, technical fixes and content optimization) is not part of hosting. Agencies commonly charge $1,000 to $3,000 or more per month for that work. Without ongoing SEO, the site's search visibility can slip over time.

Wondering why ongoing SEO matters? Why SEO Really Matters explains it in plain language, and it is ready to share with your board or finance team.

Hosting begins before launch and continues month to month until either party ends it with thirty (30) days written notice. Rankings and traffic results depend on many factors and are not guaranteed.
How It Compares To WordPress Hosting

A $35 WordPress host and a BluWeb™ plan are not the same thing. Here is what each one covers, side by side.

BLUWEB™ HOSTINGWordPress Hosting
Monthly price$35 per site$35 (the quote you shared)
How you edit✓ Visual drag and drop editor: click, type and move things on the page itself.✗ WordPress includes a block editor with limited layout control. Fuller visual page builders are separate plugins, each with its own learning curve.
Who updates your content✓ Your team, after training. Includes a video walkthrough and a full online support portal.✗ Your team, after training.
Plugin and theme updates✓ None to manage. Features are built in, so there are no plugins to keep updated.✗ Usually not covered by hosting plans, so they fall to your team or cost extra.
Complexity and security risk✓ Features are built into the platform. There is no plugin stack to add, update or secure.✗ Custom features come from added plugins, each from a different developer and each needing its own updates. In 2025, 11,334 new vulnerabilities were found across WordPress, 91% of them in plugins, and 46% had no fix when they were disclosed.
Speed and performance✓ Cloud hosting with a built-in content delivery network (CDN) and caching, so pages load fast without extra setup.✗ Depends on the host, theme and plugins chosen. Speed often needs premium hosting and a caching plugin.
Technical SEO setup✓ Built in. Sitemap, canonical tags and schema markup are generated automatically.✗ Set up by hand or with plugins, and each plugin needs its own updates.
Security✓ Automated DDoS protection, auto-renewing SSL, encrypted data, SOC 2 Type II and ISO/IEC 27001 certified platform.✗ Server-level protection. Malware cleanup and in-site hardening are usually excluded.
Backups✓ Automatic backup each time you publish, plus manual backups.✗ Basic server snapshots are typical.
AI✓ BluVibe™ AI Editor: chat with your site to change anything. +$200/mo (rolling out soon).✗ WordPress 7.0 includes an AI connection layer, but no built-in content AI. It needs a separate plugin and an outside AI account.
Ongoing cost✓ Flat and predictable. Features are built in, so there are no add-on plugin fees.✗ Can creep up over time as premium plugins, themes and add-ons are added.
If you ever leave✓ The same site moves to a BluWeb™ account in your name: same platform, same editor, same pages and content. You choose a subscription for it.✗ To move the site exactly as it is, you must stay on WordPress: another WordPress host, which usually means finding a web or marketing company that works with the same theme and plugins. Host-specific setups, email and links may also need rework.

/ / / 03 · The Platform

Your Site, Easy To Edit

This is BluWeb™, the platform your site is built on. These are real screens from the editor, shown on an example church site. Everything is drag and drop. Your pages sit in a list on the left, and clicking anything on the page opens its settings on the right. Make changes as often as you like, undo any of them, and nothing goes live until you click Republish. Bulletins, staff and small groups live in simple collections that fill in like a spreadsheet, so adding one is a new row, not a rebuild. After launch you receive a full video walkthrough and a support portal.

Screens are from an example church site built on BluWeb™. Your site will be designed in your own brand.
/ / / 04 · The Work In Detail

What's Inside

Everything below is in the build. Your site is built on BluWeb™, the way we build websites, with the features, SEO tools and AI helpers a church site needs.

Everything In The Build
Powered ByBluWeb™

A custom site that looks like St. John's, connects to Church Management System and YouTube, and is built to be found.

Design And Structure
  • Custom design shaped by your worship and your community, not a template
  • Clear structure: about 30 menu links become a short path: Visit, Worship, Learn, Give, Connect
  • Plan Your Visit page with the answers first-time families look for
  • One address on https: stjlutheranchurch.org and stjlutheran.org become one site.
  • Accessible by design: alt text, readable contrast, keyboard-friendly menus
  • Pastoral review of every doctrinal and worship page before it publishes
Church Management System And YouTube
  • Give button on every page that goes straight to your Church Management System giving
  • Events and calendar that follow Church Management System, so the website never goes stale again
  • Groups and registrations linked into the site once they are turned on in Church Management System
  • Directory stays safely behind the Church Management System login.
  • Bulletins and newsletters carried over so nothing in your archive is lost
  • Sermon library from YouTube playlists organized by series, with the latest sermon on the home page. YouTube is the second most visited website in the world after Google, so a findable library helps families discover St. John's
  • Sermon-only uploads, if you can: a 15 to 20 minute sermon is far easier to share than a full service.
Photos And Video
  • Video: like The Ridge, I can include video and photos if you have any, and nothing professional is needed (phone footage and everyday photos work well)
  • Stock or AI photos: if you do not have enough, I can use high-quality stock or AI-generated photos at no extra charge.
Search And Visibility
  • SEO-driven content for the questions people ask and the places you serve, including Corcoran and Maple Grove
  • All on-page SEO: titles, descriptions, headings, image alt text and structured data
  • Measurement: Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console set up and reporting
  • Redirects from every old page address so no bookmark or search listing breaks
Your Monthly Plan
  • BluWeb™ Hosting, $35/mo per site: hosting, maintenance, security and backups, with your team making the updates in the drag and drop editor after training
Your Site Map

There is no page cap on the initial build. This is the sitemap we recommend: about 35 pages, and every line below is its own page. The five main menu pages come first, with the pages under each beneath them. The Home page is not in the menu because your logo links to it. Every page is aimed at something families actually search for, nothing is added just to add pages, and related topics share one page where that serves visitors and search better. Your existing sermons come over as individual pages, events and blog posts add pages as you go, and we add Privacy, Accessibility and a custom 404 page.

How Site Reviews Work

We are generous with building pages, writing content and reviewing. You will see the work at each stage:

  • Home page design review: you see the home page design first.

Getting Started

  1. Sign The Agreement

    A short engagement letter confirms the build and what is included.

  2. Complete The Style Guide

    Fill out a 50-question online Style Guide with your stakeholders. We turn the answers into the site map and copy, then hold a 30-minute strategy call before kickoff.

  3. Grant Access

    Use this secure link to share access in a few clicks: Church Management System, your domain registrar, Google Business Profile and YouTube.

  4. Share Photos And Files

    Send any logo or artwork you use today, color preferences and best photos or video of worship and your people. Phone quality is fine, and we add stock or AI images at no extra charge.

  5. Start Monthly Hosting

    Hosting begins before launch at $35/mo per site.
